name: Neev
source:
Personality and tone of voice not too different from reality.

Legend has it that it took her three days to decide on a name for her character. Her name, Neev, is masculine and she doesn't explain herself at all.

She was thought to be a male player until the protagonist meets her in real life. She has a naturally cool aura about her.

She is a skillful player.

Name Offline: Ogushi Yuniko
Level: 31 >> 38
Attribute: Wind
Class: Beginner >> Swordsman >> Samurai

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/online/character/yuniko.htm]official site[/url]]
